commits.message:
fix(demos): live-terminal rows sit at the page's line height; the claude-sessions footer fits 80 columns (rich-demos-z4hd)

xterm makes a row its measured character height times its lineHeight option,
rounded to device pixels, so the factor live-terminal.ts handed it never landed
on the page's line height: rows were 20px against a 17.5px line, and the landing
showcase grew 483px -> 543px on its first frame. xterm now measures its
character at the page's line height (custom.css) with the option left at 1,
and that line height is rounded to a whole pixel so static output and live
rows share it.

The claude-sessions footer is one Layout row and wrapped when narrower than
its hints, cutting "q quit" at 80 columns with no sign. It now draws the
leading hints that fit and counts the rest ("+8 more"); the lists lead with
moving, focus and quit.

fix(palette): a fully transparent palette variable draws no background (rich-palette-ufxd) (#305)

* fix(palette): a fully transparent palette variable draws no background (rich-palette-ufxd)

A theme's #00000000 (link-background, markdown-h*-background, footer-*-background
in 22 bundled themes) is Textual's "no background". The palette drew it onto
its own background like any tint, so bg (color "link-background") cut a
background-coloured box into a surface or panel row.

A Palette now hands an alpha-0 colour out unchanged, and a Style reads a fully
transparent bgcolor as no bgcolor, so a style added over another keeps that
one's background in both the SGR bytes and resolveLook.

* fix(palette): no-colour stays out of colour math; one rule for every producer (rich-palette-ufxd)

Review of #305: a #00000000 palette var reached darken, mix, contrastOn, ramp
and the rest, which composited it over black. They now refuse it at the one gate
every colour argument crosses, naming the fix. drawnOn and opaqueOnly own the
alpha-0 rule, so buildPalette and getThemeBaseColors agree with Palette; ink
refuses a transparent key; the rich-config palette chips show it on the
background it lets through.

* fix(palette): buildPalette refuses a fully transparent base colour (rich-palette-ufxd)

drawnOn now hands #00000000 back as itself, so buildPalette would have derived
on-*, *-muted and text-* from no colour, composited over black.
